column2: Pungent, bitter and astringent tastes cause wind and destroy phlegm; pungent, sour and salty are to be known as increasing bile;
bitter, sweet and astringent destroy bile. This quality belongs not to the taste but is desired of the post-digestive effect.
Hot-potency ones destroy phlegm and wind; cold ones destroy bile; and by special power they act likewise, Sushruta.
In the cool season, spring and summer in order, accumulation, aggravation and pacification of phlegm are declared;
in summer, the rains and autumn, Sushruta, accumulation, aggravation and pacification of wind are declared;
in the cloud season, autumn and winter in order, likewise those of bile are declared.
The release period begins with the rains, and the three beginning with winter; the taking-up period with the cool season, the three seasons ending in summer;
the release is lunar, the taking-up is solar, it is declared. The Moon, moving through the three seasons beginning with the rains,
produces in turn the sour, salty and sweet tastes in order; the Sun, moving through the seasons beginning with the cool season,
increases the bitter, astringent and pungent in order. As nights increase, strength alone increases,
and for men it gradually decreases as they decline: of night-eaters, of days, and likewise of age.
In the beginning, middle and end, phlegm, bile and wind go to aggravation; at the start of aggravation is their accumulation remembered;
in the time after aggravation their pacification is declared. From overeating, Brahmin, and from not eating,
all diseases arise, and from forcing or holding natural urges. One should fill two parts of the belly with food, one with drink,
and one should leave one part as the seat of wind and the rest; the medicine is the opposite of the disease's cause;
this alone is to be done here — the essence declared by me. Above the navel and below, and the anus and hips,
are declared the places of phlegm, bile and wind in the body. Yet these pervade the body, wind especially.
In the middle of the body is the heart, remembered as the seat of the mind. Lean, with scanty hair, fickle, talkative, with irregular digestion,
and dreaming of flying — is called of wind constitution. Prematurely grey, angry, sweating, fond of sweets,
and seeing bright things in dreams — is called of bile constitution. Firm-limbed, steady-minded, radiant, with glossy hair,
and seeing clear waters in dreams is a man of phlegm constitution. Tamasic, rajasic and sattvic are likewise remembered:
men, tiger among sages, are of wind, bile and phlegm nature. Blood-bile comes from intercourse and from taking on heavy tasks;
wind is aggravated in the body by bad food and by grief; of those who use burning foods, and fiery things, hot food and travel,
bile is aggravated, and by fear likewise, twice-born. Of those who drink too much water, eat heavy food, and sleep after eating,
phlegm is aggravated, and of those who are lazy. Having known the diseases arising from wind and the rest, they are to be calmed by their marks:
breaking pain of bones, astringent taste in the mouth, dry mouth, yawning and horripilation — the mark of a wind disease;
yellowness of nails, eyes and veins, bitterness in the mouth, thirst, burning and heat — the sign of a bile disease;
laziness, salivation, heaviness, sweet taste in the mouth and desire for warmth — the mark of a phlegm disease.
Oily, warm food, anointing, drinking oil and the like destroy wind; ghee, milk, sugar and the like, and moonbeams, destroy bile;
triphala oil with honey, exercise and the like remove phlegm. For pacification of all diseases, there should be meditation on Vishnu and worship.
Food, intercourse and sleep — effort in these should always be (moderate); by not practicing and by overpracticing one meets utter destruction.
The wasted are to be nourished, the stout-bodied reduced, the middling body protected — three kinds of bodies are held.
Two treatments are told: nourishing and non-nourishing. One should eat what is beneficial, eat in moderation, and eat only when digested.
The preparation of herbs is fivefold: juice, paste, boiled decoction, cold infusion and hot infusion, best of men.
Juice is to be known as pressed; paste arises from stirring; boiled is the decoction; cold is that kept overnight;
what is quickly boiled and filtered is called phanta. The operations are a hundred and sixty more, it is remembered.
One who knows them is unconquerable, strong-armed in connection. Purity of food is for fire; strength of men is rooted in digestive fire.
One should eat with rock salt and triphala, giving color; jangala broth with rock salt, curds, milk and pippali.
A man should make it equal, or with more broth, even one with excess wind. In summer rubbing is told; in the cool season much equal;
in spring it is to be known as moderate; in summer rubbing is strong. The skin should be rubbed first, then the limb;
in sinews, blood and body, the bone appears as if fleshy. Shoulders, arms, likewise shanks with knees,
the wise should rub as if an enemy; the collarbone and chest as before. Having pressed repeatedly in all joints of the limbs,
one should extend the joints but not by sudden throwing. One should not exercise when undigested; nor a man who has eaten and drunk;
in a quarter of the day, after half a watch, exercise should not be done; one should bathe once with cold water.
One should give up warm water after exertion and not hold the breath; exercise destroys phlegm, rubbing destroys wind;
bathing destroys excess bile, and at its end sunshine is pleasant. Men who exercise safely in the beginning endure the trouble of heat.
Jati leaf and fruit, the three pungents, gargle, urine, turmeric; oil cooked in milk decoction with abhaya paste destroys the pain of the teeth.
Dhanya water, coconut, cow-urine, with kramuka and vishva, boiled — a gargle should be made for the pacification of the tongue disease.
Oil prepared in langali paste with nirgundi juices destroys goitre and neck swellings by nasal treatment.
With leaves of arka, putika, snuhi, rujaghata and jati, one should rub with cow-urine, destroying all skin diseases.
Vakuchi with sesame eaten for a year destroys leprosy; pathya, bhallataka and a ball of oil and jaggery conquer leprosy.
Buttermilk joined with putika, chitraka, turmeric, triphala and the three pungents should be drunk in piles; or eat abhaya with jaggery.
A decoction of phala, darvi and vishana, or amalaka juice, or turmeric paste with honey should be drunk by one with urinary disorder.
Vasa-based decoction of vyadhighata with castor oil, by drinking removes wind-blood; pippali removes the spleen.
For one with abdominal disease, pippali steeped repeatedly in snuhi milk is to be used; or milk with dantī, chitraka, vidanga and the three pungents paste;
granthika, ugra, abhaya and krishna smeared with vidanga, kept in ghee; meat, buttermilk — destroys sprue, piles, anemia, abdominal tumor and worms.
Triphala, guduchi, vasa, bitter bhunimba decoction with honey would destroy anemia together with jaundice.
One with blood-bile should drink the fine juice of vasa with sugar and honey; or milk prepared separately with vari, grapes, bala and ginger.
Vari, vidari, pathya, the three balas with vasaka, with shvadamshtra, honey and ghee — a consumptive should lick it.
Pathya, shigru, karanja, arka bark-essence with honey and rock salt, with urine, kills abscess, conquers disease, for ripening.
Trivrit, jivanti, danti, manjishtha, the two sarvari, tarkshaja and neem leaf — a paste is praised in fistula.
Powder of rujaghata, jani, lac with goat's honey: a cloth-wick should be applied in a wound, cleansing it and destroying its track.
Oil cooked in milk with shyama, yashti, turmeric, lodhra, padmaka, utpala, sandal and pepper heals wounds.
With leaves of cotton, ash, fruit, stone-salt, turmeric — sweating with a ball of it in copper with oil is a wound medicine.
One should apply kumbhi essence with milk on a fire-burn wound; the same destroys by pouring; coconut powder with ghee.
With vishva, ajamoda, rock salt, tamarind bark and abhaya equal, with buttermilk or warm water, drunk it destroys diarrhea.
Water boiled with vatsaka, ativisha, vishva, bilva and mustaka one should give in diarrhea, old and with mucus and with blood and colic.
Rock salt burned with embers, well taken, should be drunk with warm water; or one with colic: rock salt, hing, pippali and abhaya.
Powder of katuroha, utkana, tanka and parched rice with honey, put in the mouth in a cloth with holes, destroys thirst.
A decoction of patha, daruharidra, jati leaf, grapes root and triphala with honey, as a gargle, removes mouth sores.
Krishna, ativisha, tikta, indra, daru, patha and mustaka, boiled in urine with honey, removes all throat diseases.
A decoction of pathya, gokshura, durasparsha, rajavriksha and shilabheda with honey, drunk, removes urinary difficulty.
A decoction of bamboo bark and varuna destroys gravel and stones; one who eats milk with decoction and honey of shakhotaka would cure elephantiasis.
Masarka bark, milk, oil and rock salt sprinkled with honey remove foot disease; ghee likewise made from a net-caught cock.
Powder of ginger, sauvarchala and hing with ginger juice and ghee removes pain; then the decoction — know it as accomplishing the held-fire.
